headline: Shane Gillis and Danny McBride made a weather forecast way more competitive than it needed
body: Shane Gillis and Danny McBride made a weather forecast way more competitive than it needed to be The two play rival weathermen in a four-minute commercial for kalshi, turning a routine broadcast into a battle over who gets the forecast right. Put these two behind a news desk and apparently nobody’s keeping it professional Would you watch a whole show with them? *KalshiPartner.
